issue_request: FHIR-7739 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 MedicationPrescription. It requested changing MedicationPrescription.medication to Medication[x] with a CodeableConcept option and a Reference(Medication) option, and it asked for clarification that manufacturer, brand, form, packaging, and similar detail should use the full Medication resource.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-7739 was found. Commit d406f9a2c017ef95928c6bc4b4ba09a89d2d3852 updated Pharmacy resources based on ballot resolutions, changed MedicationPrescription.medication to medication[x] CodeableConcept|Reference(Medication), and added initial code-vs-resource guidance. Commit 6c59909a7c012358eb432b38e2f8630e5b0923f4 later applied FHIR-10389 by updating MedicationRequest, MedicationAdministration, MedicationStatement, and MedicationDispense medication comments with explicit form/lot guidance.
additional_context: FHIR-7562, which FHIR-7739 named as the clarification vehicle, later resolved Not Persuasive/No Change after Medication.code definitions had been rewritten. FHIR-10389 supplied the later final guidance that matches FHIR-7739's clarification request. FHIR-25929 intentionally converted Pharmacy CodeableConcept|Reference choices to CodeableReference(Medication) in R5, preserving the same choice semantics in the current model.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit.
